quotes.text: The patient persona and scoring key remain inaccessible to the agent.

contradiction_quotes.text: The patient persona and scoring key remain inaccessible to the agent.
It could therefore read the answer key in `/var/lib/caa`.

parsed.rationale: The paper states the agent cannot access the scoring key and names the mechanism as hidden/inaccessible scoring criteria. The README caveat reports a contradictory condition under Harbor 0.1.44 where the agent may read the answer key.
